# deko3d algorithm attribution

`dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_tex.c` ports the storage-size/alignment and mip-level layout algorithm
from deko3d `source/dk_image.cpp`. The existing source header identifies fincs,
Copyright (C) 2018-2020. It is an adapted C implementation, not an unmodified deko3d file.

The exact historical import revision was not recorded; do not infer one from this audit.
For verification, upstream `master` was resolved on 2026-10-30 to
`373bfd43d8b2d805fa2eb7d406dbb823032df958`. Its original [LICENSE](LICENSE) is
included verbatim and matches the attribution already in the source.

Source reference: <https://github.com/devkitPro/deko3d/blob/373bfd43d8b2d805fa2eb7d406dbb823032df958/source/dk_image.cpp>.
This directory contains license/provenance material only.
